EmailTemplate.subject: Your letter reprint is ready for pickup.

Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Your letter is ready for pickup. Please come to the Student Services Building, room 112, front window. Make sure you bring a picture ID with you (i.e., ASU ID, driver's license, passport).
Thank you,
Admission Services Arizona State University
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
